summary_for_children: Surah Luqman tells of a wise man, Luqman, who gave his son advice: never worship anything besides Allah, be grateful to parents, pray, be patient, don't be proud, walk gently and lower your voice.
environment_concept: A quiet family garden where each path holds one piece of Luqman's advice to his son, under trees and beside a sea of ink.
architecture_and_scenery: Courtyard garden with a central rock, a mustard plant, slow paths, and a shoreline where the sea stretches like ink.

palette.lighting: Warm afternoon in a family garden

areas.name: The Rock and the Mustard Seed
areas.description: A large rock with a tiny seed nearby.

areas.name: Sea of Ink
areas.description: A shore where trees become pens and the sea ink.

activities.name: Advice path
activities.description: Walk each path and match the advice to its ayah.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Lower your voice
activities.description: Practise a calm voice level in a playful sound game (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration explains each piece of advice; Luqman and his son are not shown or voiced, only the ayahs are read.

ayah_environment_connections.element: The Rock and the Mustard Seed

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
